name: What flooring options are best for high-traffic areas in a home?

mainEntity.name: What flooring options are best for high-traffic areas in a home?

acceptedAnswer.text: For high-traffic areas like entryways, kitchens, and hallways, durable flooring materials are recommended. Luxury Vinyl Plank (LVP) and Luxury Vinyl Tile (LVT) are excellent choices due to their water resistance, scratch resistance, and ease of cleaning. Engineered hardwood offers a natural look with good durability, especially those with a strong wear layer. Porcelain or ceramic tile is also highly resilient and can withstand significant wear and tear, making them suitable for active households. Carpet is generally not recommended for high-traffic zones as it tends to show wear more quickly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Durable options like Luxury Vinyl Plank/Tile, engineered hardwood, and porcelain/ceramic tile are best for high-traffic areas due to their resistance to wear and moisture.
